module_summary: Serial 1001 sequence detector: a one-hot 5-state Moore FSM advances on data_in bits and asserts sequence_detected in state S4.

anchors.name: curr_state
anchors.why: One-hot state register IDLE..S4 tracking matched prefix of 1001 from data_in.

anchors.name: sequence_detected
anchors.why: Detection output decoded from curr_state == S4.

groups.name: detector_fsm
groups.description: One-hot Moore FSM with next_state logic driven by data_in; decodes detection output.
